from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxInfo(BaseModel):
    """One company's taxes payable data extracted from its financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from this document")
    taxes_payable: float | None = Field(description="The '应交税费' end-of-period balance amount")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    category: str | None = Field(description="Category classification: '高税费', '中税费', '低税费' (to be computed by inference agent)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_info: list[CompanyTaxInfo]
